sonnet.problem: The true or false statement bundles two separate claims (the wicked are overthrown and perish, and the house of the righteous will stand). Both are true, so the card tests two things at once.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The true or false statement bundles two separate claims (the ways of the wicked lead them astray, and a righteous man is cautious in friendship). Both are true, so the card tests two things at once.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: "Stupid" is the only negative answer. The wrong answers "Humble" and "Honest" are positive traits that no one would use as a name for someone who hates correction, so they are not believable and the right answer stands out.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. / Wrong answers for what someone does or says only need to be believable.
